### Welcome to my personal website!

I am a PhD student in Agricultural and Natural Resource Economics at Colorado State University. My research interests are in environmental economics, natural hazards, flood risk management, early warning systems, and applied econometrics.

My current research studies how flood risk, flood warnings, and public risk information affect economic behavior and local outcomes. I work with large administrative and spatial datasets, including NOAA weather alerts, flood events, FEMA disaster declarations, employment data, and community-level flood mitigation records.

Please visit my [research](research.qmd) page or read more [about me](bio.qmd) if you are interested in my work.
